summary: Analysis of the top Chinese server Vortex IV leaderboard reveals a major meta shift to Corrosion, reaching 72.8+ billion damage. The top-ranking team transitioned away from traditional pure Toxin to a Corrosion composition centered on Rhyviel and supported by Sia. Child of Chaos requires high Skill Haste (73–78) to optimize cycling at Inspiration 5. Meanwhile, high-performing Dauntless teams are pairing Fire with Lightning affinity, replacing Maashtur with an Inspiration 5 Scaarr.

heroes.note: Serves as an essential support for Rhyviel in high-scoring Corrosion teams, benefiting heavily from the Secrecy gear set, Accuracy, and Skill Haste.

Equip Sia with the Secrecy set and prioritize both Accuracy and Skill Haste.
